description:
The IANA zone at a point and the UTC offset its clocks kept at that local date and time, from the tz database, never a fixed offset: Kyiv answers +2 in January, +3 in July and +4 on 15 May 1990, when it kept Moscow summer time. `time` defaults to 12:00 and matters on the day clocks change; a skipped hour resolves to the offset from before the change, a repeated one to its first occurrence. `standardOffset` is the smaller of the year's offsets and `isDst` is true when the clock is ahead of it.

[Group: Astro-Geography]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/geo/timezone]
[Required: lat, lon]
[Cost: 5 credits (Tier ½)]

date.description: Local calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD` at the point. Defaults to today (UTC).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, north positive.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

time.description: Local clock time `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`. Matters only on the day clocks change.

name: astroway_geo_timezone
title: Time zone and UTC offset at a point
